description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View named 'GeneralSettings' which provides a comprehensive user interface for managing various application settings related to the OpenClaw macOS app. It includes UI components for gateway management, remote connection configuration, health status display, and diagnostic tools, along with associated state handling and external service interactions.

classes.name: GeneralSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View handling the application's general settings interface, including gateway management, remote connection options, and health diagnostics.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and updates the current gateway environment status.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous test of the remote gateway connection and updates the status accordingly.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Attempts to locate and reveal the logs file in Finder; shows an alert if the log file is not found.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Applies the selected discovered gateway to the current application state.
